about_the_game:
Overview

The demo of Make Magic Great Again offers a first glimpse into the revival of lost magic. Begin as an exiled mage, kindle the sparks of elemental power, and face relentless waves of demons in a short but intense adventure.

This trial showcases the game’s core loop: survive endless hordes, unlock elemental skills, and fuse them into powerful ancient formulas. Play solo or with friends, and experience the spectacle of co-op resonance magic.

Demo Content

  • Eight Core Elements: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Light, Dark

  • Elemental Formulas: Try out multiple dual-element combinations and unleash devastating spells

  • Auto-Casting Combat: Focus on survival and movement while spells fire automatically

  • Enemy Waves: Encounter early-game monsters, elites, and a preview of boss battles

  • Co-op Play: Support for 1–4 players, with unique resonance effects triggered in teams

Highlights

✅ Experience the journey from sparks to magical revival
✅ Solo epic or co-op spectacle
✅ Roguelike replayability with new surprises every run
✅ Stunning spell effects and immersive sound design

short_description: A Roguelike survivor-style action game of elemental mastery. Harness eight core elements, survive endless demon hordes, and join up to 4 players in co-op to unleash ancient formulas—embark on an epic journey to revive the lost glory of magic!
